description: For warranty repair, this completion sign-off form records reported defect, diagnostic plan, coverage, access, parts, repair method, collateral restoration, and scheduling. Its supporting evidence includes intake photos, installation record, diagnostic readings, removed-part findings, repair photos, and functional test.

blocks.guidance: Link this warranty repair record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Warranty Repair Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture original work order, installed component, location, completion date, warranty term, customer, and prior callbacks for this warranty repair.
blocks.label: Warranty Repair Core Identifiers

blocks.guidance: Explain each unnecessary warranty repair evidence item.
items: Source, date, author, and version can be identified
Measurements include units and test conditions
Photos or attachments identify their location and purpose
Unknown or inaccessible conditions are conspicuous

blocks.guidance: Escalate hazards, active property damage, repeated failure, disputed responsibility, or work outside trade qualification. Route unresolved warranty repair work for review.
blocks.label: Warranty Repair Applicable Review Boundary

subtitle: Warranty Repair Completion Sign-Off Form: trade warranty repair dispatch and verification using original work order, reported defect, and intake photos.
title: Warranty Repair Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during trade warranty repair dispatch and verification when the warranty repair record must identify original work order, installed component, location, completion date, warranty term, customer, and prior callbacks. Complete the applicable handoff for repair verification, customer acceptance, coverage disposition, recurrence action, costs, and warranty-record update.
